title: Typical periodic optimization and freezing phase transition: Dini potentials and beyond
summary: We investigate the Typical Periodic Optimization (TPO) Conjecture and freezing phase transitions for Dini potentials and beyond. We show that the TPO conjecture fails already at Dini regularity. We identify a sharp regularity threshold for freezing phase transitions, which we call weak log-log Dini. Both results reveal the stability of aperiodic ground states. Moreover, we identify Dini regularity as the sharp threshold for a quantitatitve analog of the freezing phase transition.
